data.one_liner: Provides a DynamicLibrary loader for the Opus codec on Flutter platforms.
data.what_it_does: It loads the native Opus library (libopus 1.3.1) for use with opus_dart. The package itself does not expose Opus functions; it only supplies the library handle.
use_when: You need Opus audio encoding/decoding in a Flutter app
You prefer a null‑safe, cross‑platform loader rather than bundling the library yourself
avoid_when: You are not using Opus or opus_dart
You need a higher‑level Opus API rather than just the library
weaknesses: Only a loader – requires opus_dart for actual usage
No direct API, just a DynamicLibrary
data.setup_notes: Add opus_flutter to pubspec and import; no native configuration required.
